_note: Read-only snapshot 2026-10-22. Nothing here was changed; the Admin API has no mutation for these settings.

api_check.COD / manual payment method: No Admin GraphQL mutation creates or enables a manual payment method (searched mutations for 'payment', 'gateway', 'manual', 'setting'). Shop.paymentSettings only exposes supportedDigitalWallets. paymentCustomization* only hides/renames/reorders existing methods and needs a Shopify Function app.
api_check.Include tax in prices: Shop.taxesIncluded is read-only. Tax mutations available: companyLocationTaxSettingsUpdate (B2B), customer tax exemptions, taxAppConfigure (tax partner apps), taxSummaryCreate. None changes taxesIncluded.

variant_taxable_flag: About 172 of 539 variants are taxable=true (Madurkathi mats/runners/fridge covers, straw bed mats, dry flower wreaths, bamboo trays/lamps/gift basket, some Sabai wall plate variants, Kaziranga/Shillong/Agartala cane planter variants). All other variants, including all 10 best-sellers, are taxable=false, so no GST is added for them at checkout.
gst_rate_seen: draftOrderCalculate on a taxable ₹750 item to Uttarakhand returned IGST 18% (₹135).
sales_taxes_last_365d: ₹0 on every product in the sales report (top 20 by gross sales).
